page_title: EVE 1-1 WOL | Everton v Wolves 07/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+9' Thomas Kirk blows his whistle as Santiago Bueno (Wolves) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
90+7' Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) jumps highest to meet an accurate cross and heads the ball towards the net. His fine header whistles just inches wide of the right post.
90+7' Andre (Wolves) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
90+7' Jackson Tchatchoua (Wolves) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Wolves win a corner.
90+5' A substitution has been made. Hee-Chan Hwang is replaced by Pedro Lima (Wolves).
90+3' Wolves take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

90+3' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) tricks his way to edge of the area and unleashes a howitzer of a shot towards the top right corner, but Jordan Pickford earns his money with a fine reflex save. The referee signals a corner kick to Wolves.
90+1' A substitution has been made. Dwight McNeil goes off and Merlin Rohl (Everton) comes on.
90' 9 additional min. will be played.
90' It is too late to protest. Jack Grealish (Everton) knew very well what he was doing and subsequently receives a second yellow card, ending the match for him.
87' David Moyes decides to make a substitution. Harrison Armstrong will be replaced by Nathan Patterson (Everton).
87' Substitution. Thierno Barry walks off the pitch and Beto (Everton) comes on as a substitute.
87' The main referee, Thomas Kirk, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Jack Grealish (Everton) is given a yellow card for dissent.
85' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Wolves.
84' Referee Thomas Kirk halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to David Moyes, then shows him a yellow.
83' He’s off! Michael Keane (Everton) gets his marching orders from referee Thomas Kirk after the VAR review.

81' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Michael Keane (Everton), but referee Thomas Kirk must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
79' Wolves fail to score from a corner as Jordan Pickford (Everton) leaps to collect the ball.
77' It's like he was asking for a caution. Tim Iroegbunam (Everton) receives a yellow card.
77' Thomas Kirk shows a yellow card to Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) for his blatant foul.
76' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Everton comes to nothing.
76' Jack Grealish (Everton) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block. The referee blows his whistle, Everton are awarded a corner kick.
75' Thierno Barry (Everton) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar.
69' 1 - 1 Matheus Mane (Wolves) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom right corner.
67' Substitution. Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) has come on for Ladislav Krejci.
67' Jack Grealish (Everton) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the left-hand post.
67' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but James Tarkowski (Everton) takes it short.
67' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Everton, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Everton.

65' Joao Gomes (Wolves) dribbled past his opponents before finding himself in a great position to strike. His attempt from just outside of the box went towards the bottom left corner, but it wasn't dangerous and Jordan Pickford made a comfortable save.
65' Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) finds space near the penalty spot to plant a header at goal from the corner, but it's badly directed and drifts well wide of the right post.
64' Wolves have been awarded a corner kick.
64' Matheus Mane (Wolves) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
64' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
63' Ladislav Krejci (Wolves) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
61' Ladislav Krejci (Wolves) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
59' Jack Grealish (Everton) sends a screamer well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
57' Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) receives a yellow card for infringement.
56' The Everton players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
54' Matheus Mane (Wolves) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.
51' Ladislav Krejci (Wolves) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
47' Ladislav Krejci (Wolves) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
47' Joao Gomes (Wolves) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Jordan Pickford easily deals with the threat.
46' Rob Edwards makes a half-time substitution. Andre (Wolves) comes on in place of Jhon Arias.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Great teamplay by Everton as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
43' Jose Sa (Wolves) is booked for saying more than Thomas Kirk was willing to tolerate.
42' Looks like Jose Sa (Wolves) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
42' The foul by Tim Iroegbunam (Everton) was seen by Thomas Kirk who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
42' James Tarkowski (Everton) commits a foul and Thomas Kirk immediately signals a free kick.
36' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but it lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the right post.

35' James Garner (Everton) cuts inside his marker and unleashes a rocket of a shot from inside the box. The ball flies towards the right side of the goal, but it's kept out by magnificent save from Jose Sa.
31' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) smashes a shot at goal from the edge of the area that drifts harmlessly past the right post.

29' Michael Keane (Everton) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick into the box and attempts to score with a header. His effort is not accurate enough and bounces away off the right post.
28' Thomas Kirk blows his whistle and signals a foul after Joao Gomes (Wolves) brought his opponent down. Everton are awarded the free kick.
25' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
25' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The linesman points to the corner flag, Wolves are going to take it.
24' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Everton, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
22' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) takes a shot from the edge of the area, but it goes harmlessly wide of the right post.
17' 1 - 0 Goal! Michael Keane (Everton) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top of the net. He makes it 1:0.
17' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Everton, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
17' Everton have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
15' Thomas Kirk blows his whistle and it's Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
14' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Wolves, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
11' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Tim Iroegbunam (Everton).
10' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) but poses no threat.
8' Tim Iroegbunam (Everton) smashes the ball from the edge of the box and misses well wide of the left post.
5' Jake O'Brien (Everton) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Jose Sa, who smothers the ball.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Everton will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Thomas Kirk.
